about: PrimeArc animatic camera path. One continuous camera, site scroll order. Blender world units = metres, Z up; *_threejs fields are converted to three.js Y-up (x, z, -y). FOV: sensor 36 mm wide; vfov for a 16:10 frame. Interpolation between keys: per-channel cubic Bezier with auto-clamped handles (ease in/out, a repeated key = hold); orientation = lookAt(target) with world up. 'shift' = lens shift (fraction of frame width) used to offset the hero subject right of centre (three.js: camera.setViewOffset). 'samples' = the exact evaluated camera for every frame at 24 fps.
